subject: SOC 2 sample request — background checks & training artifacts (collection plan)
messages:
From: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@security-audit.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 request — sample of background checks & training logs

Hi Mina,

As part of the upcoming SOC 2 fieldwork for Greenfield Health (scheduled week of Nov 9), our audit team needs a sample of personnel evidence for employee onboarding controls. Specifically we are requesting: 

- Background check confirmations for 5 recent hires (redacted PII is acceptable)
- Training completion records for security awareness and data handling (CSV or PDF snapshot)
- Onboarding access logs showing account provisioning for the sampled individuals
- The current personnel onboarding policy and retention schedule

Ideally we'd receive these materials by COB Mon 1 Nov to allow tagging and initial review. If there are any concerns around PII or regulatory redaction, please flag them and propose an alternative.

Can you confirm who on your side will curate the sample and whether a shared Drive link is preferred?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
SOC 2 Audit Lead
Security Audit Partners

From: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
To: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@security-audit.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request — sample of background checks & training logs

Laura / Audit team,

Thanks — we can provide a redacted sample and a short collection plan. Proposed approach: 

1) Provide 5 redacted background-check confirmations (names replaced with employee IDs, DOB removed, verified status + vendor reference). File: bg-checks-sample-redacted.pdf
2) Provide training completion snapshot containing employee ID, course name, date completed, and completion status. File: training-completion-snapshot-2026.csv
3) Provide provisioning log extract (date of account creation, system, employee ID). File: onboarding-access-log-2025-2026.csv
4) Provide current onboarding/personnel policy and stated retention period. File: personnel-onboarding-policy-2024-10.pdf

We will upload these to a restricted Drive folder and share a link. I will also include a short manifest describing redaction methodology.

Owners: 
- I will assemble and upload the artifacts (Mina Haddad, Security & Compliance Program Manager)
- Marissa Cole (People Ops) will confirm the background-check vendor statements for the sampled hires
- Vivek Kulkarni (Security) will review redactions for adequacy before sharing externally

Target delivery: by end of day Mon 1 Nov. If you need a subset sooner, let me know which files to prioritize.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: manifest-redaction-notes.txt (see below)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
To: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request — sample of background checks & training logs

Mina — quick guidance before you share externally: 

- Ensure all background check records have direct identifiers replaced with employee IDs and that the vendor assertion (vendor name, check date, and verification status) remains visible.
- Remove DOB, SSN/NI, and scanned ID images.
- For training CSVs, remove free-text notes that could contain PII. Provide a column indicating whether training is mandatory or optional.
- Add a one-paragraph statement confirming our retention policy and the legal basis for any employee data handling in the manifest.

If the Drive link will be external, use the expiring link option (7 days) and require viewer access only. Also mark the folder with an audit tag so we can trace downloads.

Thanks — looping in Marissa for the vendor confirmations.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
To: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@security-audit.com>, compliance@greenfieldhealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request — sample of background checks & training logs (Delivery)

Hi Laura / Greenfield team,

We uploaded the requested sample materials into a restricted Drive folder and applied the redaction and sharing controls Vivek recommended. Access link (view only, expires in 7 days): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-greenfield-audit 

Files included (redacted where indicated):
- bg-checks-sample-redacted.pdf (employee IDs only, vendor assertion included)
- training-completion-snapshot-2026.csv (PII removed; column showing mandatory/optional)
- onboarding-access-log-2025-2026.csv (provisioning events by employee ID, system, and date)
- personnel-onboarding-policy-2024-10.pdf
- manifest-redaction-notes.txt (explains redaction steps and retention policy)

Marissa confirmed the background vendor for the sampled hires is ClearHire Solutions; vendor statements are included in the manifest. Per your request, we applied audit tags to the Drive folder and set a 7-day expiry for the link. If you require the original, unredacted vendor confirmations under an NDA, let us know and we will route that through our legal team.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you need any additional fields in the CSVs (employee role, org, or hire date) — we can add those as a second extract if helpful.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (uploaded to Drive): bg-checks-sample-redacted.pdf; training-completion-snapshot-2026.csv; onboarding-access-log-2025-2026.csv; personnel-onboarding-policy-2024-10.pdf; manifest-redaction-notes.txt
